text:
ada: FYI — short maintenance planned next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Goal: warm reboots of NIC/kernel on gpu-rack pools + affinity sanity checks. Staggering per-rack to avoid big KV cache churn.

ada: High-level plan:
- cordon -> drain (graceful) -> reboot -> uncordon
- run affinity verification script to rehydrate KV prefixes for serving lanes
- backfill from spare-pool-1 while each rack is down
- canary rack first (rack-7) then parallel 2 racks max

ada: I put a calendar invite and a runbook in the infra-runbooks folder. Expect ~6–8 nodes/rack, ~10–12m per node drain+reboot.

michael: question — spare-pool-1 capacity is finite, do we want to pre-scale it to avoid eviction of spot workers?

ada: good catch. plan: pre-scale to +15% for the window, then scale down 30m after. cost estimate ~ +$120/hr for region.

sanjay: heads up — there is a long-running retrain in eu-west scheduled same night (batch-ml-job-992). If spare pool trims, that job could OOM/evict. Can we move that job to lower priority or delay 1h?

julia: recommend reducing batch concurrency rather than moving jobs. Also suggest we run cache-warm probe after canary reboot: simple curl traffic to top 50 prefixes to avoid cold-start tail latency.

ada: agree on both. i'll set batch job to low-priority and add a pre-warm hook:

```
# cache-warm pseudo
for prefix in $(cat /opt/infra/top-prefixes.txt); do
  curl -sS -H "x-debug: warm" https://svc-infer/$prefix >/dev/null &
done
wait
```

nora: do we need any LB/routing changes? service affinity currently uses session labels on pods — if we drain, sessions should migrate but want to know if we need manual controller tweak.

ada: no LB changes planned; affinity labels are respected. we'll monitor 5xx and p99 latency during canary. rollback plan: abort remaining drains and shift traffic off the pool if p99 > 300ms or error rate > 0.5%.

michael: can you add a quick pre/post checklist in the thread? ops-sre can run through it before we start.

ada: done — pre-checklist: (1) spare-pool scaled +15% (2) canary rack clear of active long jobs (3) evict-propagation-time set to 10m (4) monitoring hooks enabled. Post-checklist: (1) verify p99 and error rate stable for 30m (2) scale spare-pool down 30m after last rack back (3) remove low-priority flag from delayed jobs.

ops-bot: calendar event created: "infra: warm-reboot + affinity checks — eu & us" — 2024-06-11T02:00:00Z. Attendees: ada, michael, sanjay, nora.

sanjay: ack, i'll delay the retrain by 1h.

julia: i'll own the canary monitoring dashboard and post updates in this thread during the window.

ada: thanks — final note: try to keep each rack to <=2 nodes offline simultaneously if possible to reduce capacity churn. posting the node list and exact start times 12 hours before. :thumbsup:
